summary: Verified ARCHAUDIT end-to-end: backend SSE endpoint POST /api/audit and frontend streaming UI. All 8 pytest backend cases passed (SSE content-type, exactly three named events in order architect_done → attack_done → final_done, full AuditResponse shape in final_done, fallback:true for all stages with empty OPENAI_API_KEY, ASCII box-drawing chars, request never errors). Playwright E2E confirmed: ARCHAUDIT logo, COMMAND TERMINAL panel, prefilled requirements-input, execute-audit-button, three idle columns transition to loaded with non-empty diagrams+summaries and amber 'STAGE_FAILED — SHOWING_CACHED_FALLBACK' banners in all three columns. UI screenshot verifies proper brutalist IDE styling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py resolve_stage summary-fallback branch: `if not summary: summary = mock_summary if diagram == mock_diagram else summary` — when diagram != mock_diagram, summary remains empty string. Minor edge case since split_response only returns non-empty diagram, but empty summary can still slip through.
Frontend fetch-stream loop has no cancellation on unmount; if user navigates away mid-stream the reader keeps running. Non-blocking for hackathon demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OPENAI_API_KEY is intentionally empty; all stages return fallback:true with deterministic MOCK_* content. If key is set later, re-run backend_test.py — the fallback:true asserts will need to be relaxed. Backend tests use module-scoped fixture to make one SSE request and reuse it across 7 assertions.
